Instruments as printed: common stock, preferred/senior equity, warrants, convertible debt with significant equity component, convertible notes, forward contracts for future delivery of stock, swaps, units of LLCs/LPs/SPVs, profit participation units (OpenAI SPV), money market fund; Private Funds capped at 15% of net assets (unlevered single-company vehicles excluded; none held as of prospectus date, 60-day notice before first such investment).
